CliAdapter — ChannelPort for local terminal REPL.

receive() reads lines from stdin and returns them as InboundMessage. send() writes text to stdout. ack() is a no-op.

This is a single-user local adapter: the user identity is fixed (local:cli) and messages are numbered sequentially.
